relationships.subject: Nav1.8
relationships.evidence_quote: the abundance of ACY1 in the spinal cord was significantly upregulated in both CFA and SNI-induced chronic pain models in wild-type mice compared with Nav1.8 knockout mice

relationships.subject: ACY1
relationships.evidence_quote: overexpression of spinal ACY1 is sufficient to contribute to mechanical allodynia in normal animals

relationships.subject: ACY1
relationships.evidence_quote: Co-immunoprecipitation results showed that there was an interactive relationship between ACY1 and SphK1 in the spinal cord of mice

relationships.subject: ACY1
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicated that ACY1 mediates the release of S1P in both CFA and SNI pain models.

relationships.subject: ACY1
relationships.evidence_quote: These data indicate that the overexpression of spinal ACY1 increases the activity of spinal dorsal horn neurons.

key_findings: ACY1 is a downstream effector of Nav1.8 in spinal cord in inflammatory and neuropathic pain.
ACY1 promotes SphK1 membrane translocation and S1P production, activating glutamatergic neurons and astrocytes.
